note: A test to see every step work on one machine: 4.8M parameters, 256-token windows. Its one global layer (layer 4) is CSA with a top 16 of its 64 merged entries, so the selection is exercised even in short windows; with 4 layers it has no room for an HCA layer. Changed on 2026-10-17: gated MLA became DeepSeek-V4's CSA (4 heads of 128 sharing one key-value head, an indexer of 2 heads of 128, V4-Flash's scaled to the width) and the MTP block's attention a 128-token window; it grew from 4.6M to 4.8M parameters, and weights trained before no longer load. Since 2026-10-17 (recipe shape 4) its training is one stage: 3000 steps of 64 windows of 256 tokens; it does not reach longer windows (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-17: recipes keep one stage for now).
